steps: Deleting a referenced state blocks generation and clears the obsolete source preview. Recreating the same spelling does not silently rebind old rows; explicit selection restores a valid table and the exact expected source.

The state-table generator previews every exact custom script byte. Its renamed attack state, added walk state, five transition rows, selected path and existing character document type persist in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px; the final source line is reachable by scrolling. Return/Create/Cancel remain visible. Cancel changes no editor state or author files.

Create script opens the normal TXT source draft and focuses its editor without any file or registration write. Ordinary Save stores the reviewed GDScript bytes under the existing character type, adds only source plus registration, and immediately makes that source visible to the existing behavior source directory.

Real GUI planning, build and Godot run execute initial idle → event attack → one natural completion → looped idle through the same generated state-table source. Separate completion and command panels display actual frozen histories; three languages at390px retain search and have no horizontal overflow.

Separate read-only controls open the frozen animation, clip and subscribing behavior declarations at their exact registered source locations. Runtime execution and source navigation leave all author files unchanged after the single deliberate TXT save.

en.text:
Natural animation completionsRead-only records of non-looping animations reaching their end naturally. Stopping, seeking to the end and loop boundaries do not produce completion notifications. History remains across scenes and resets on a new run.

ja.text:

    処理済みは同期コールバックの成功を表し、その後のアニメーションコマンドの実行完了を保証しません。スキップは購読解除、シーン退出、新しいアニメーションコマンドなどによって発生し、恒久的な購読解除を意味しません。
